days.title: Lakes and Sanctuaries
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Muddusjaure
stops.detail: About half of the park's area is primeval forest, while the other half consists of lakes such as the Muddusjaure, the Luobbalape and the Stuor-Muddus as well as extensive marshlands.

stops.name: Vogelschutzgebiete
stops.detail: There are two bird sanctuaries in the park, to which access is prohibited during the summer months, a large one in the center of the park and one at the southern edge.

stops.name: Eingang am südlichen Ende
stops.detail: From national road 45 (or 97), a 12 km long dead-end road leads to the entrance at the southern end of the park.

stops.name: Muddus-Wasserfall
stops.detail: Muddus waterfall with a height of 42 m about 10 km north of the entrance
